messages:
sam (People Ops): Quick ask — can folks sanity-check this "one-line self-review" cheat sheet I'm drafting for ICs and managers? Want something people can paste into reviews in <2 mins.

anya (Manager, Eng Growth): Love a super-short version. Key is examples for different levels (IC, EM, PM).

sam (People Ops): Draft below — please reply with edits/noises: 

```
ONE-LINE SELF-REVIEW CHEAT SHEET (paste-ready)

For ICs (engineer/data/science):
- Outcome (1 line): What shipped + measurable impact. e.g. "Reduced recs p95 latency 18% (420ms→344ms) improving CTR by 0.7pts".
- Role (1 line): What you did. e.g. "Led async batching rollout; owned perf tests and rollout plan".
- Tradeoff / risk (1 line): e.g. "Introduced extra cache memory during peak; monitoring in place".
- Ask (one line): e.g. "Need 40 node-hours for canary week 8 or pairing for kernel tuning".

For EMs / Leads (1 line each bullet):
- Team outcome: e.g. "Delivered search re-rank feature, improving successful queries by 12%".
- Team enablement: e.g. "Removed two blocking infra tickets; hired contractor for sprints 3-6".
- Risk/mitigation: e.g. "Dependency on partner API; mitigation: fallback & canary policy".
- Skip-level note (optional): one sentence to help calibration.

For PMs / Product (1 line each):
- User outcome: e.g. "Launched onboarding flow; increased activation by 9%".
- Signal: metric + timeframe.
- Tradeoffs & next steps.

Naming hints for goals/OKRs (short, machine friendly):
- format: team.short_goal.quarter  e.g. "platform.cache-hit.q3"
- include metric suffix when relevant: ".p95" ".activation"

Manager micro-phrases (use in 1:1s):
- "What's the smallest outcome that proves this idea?"  
- "Which metric will change if we ship this? How much is 'good enough'?"  
- "If this stalls, what do we stop doing to free capacity?"  

Calibration quick-check (for managers to paste in doc):
- Green = Outcome + metric met
- Amber = Outcome shipped, metric near target (within 10-15%) or partial scope
- Red = Not shipped / blocker; explain tradeoffs
```

kevin (PM): This is great. One tiny ask: include a micro-example for non-quant metrics (research, docs). E.g. "Published 6 research notes; received 3 internal adopters".

lydia (Recruiting Ops): Also add a hiring ops tag suggestion so managers can request headcount in reviews: e.g. add "[HC-REQ]" at the end of the Ask line. So it's easy to filter.

sam (People Ops): Good call @lydia — adding an example: "Ask: add HC-REQ for 1 SWE to support infra; justification: reducing on-call load 30%".

anya (Manager, Eng Growth): For skip-levels: please include a one-line manager calibration box we can paste in manager notes: 
- "Manager note: scope changes approved by product; agreed to shift two tickets to Q+1; see tradeoffs."

sam (People Ops): Perfect. I'll fold these in and push the final cheat sheet to the templates folder and pin it in #people-ops. ETA: today. Thanks! :sparkles: 

hr-bot: Cheat sheet uploaded: https://redwood.internal/templates/one-line-selfreview-v1 (uploaded by sam) :white_check_mark:

kevin (PM): Will share in product sync. Short & actionable wins again.

lydia (Recruiting Ops): Adding filter on HC-REQ in ATS now so we can pick up asks from reviews automatically.

sam (People Ops): Thanks all — if you see anything missing ping me or drop edits in the doc.
